_about: Fixes for known errors or gaps in the source catalogues, keyed by HYG id. Each entry replaces only the fields it lists; 'why' records the reason.

24549.why: HYG v4.4 lists Capella's primary as 'M1: comp'. Capella Aa is a K0 III giant.

118493.why: Procyon B: HYG's type 'DA' has no temperature index. 7,740 K is the commonly cited value.

118281.why: 40 Eridani B: HYG gives DA4 (~12,600 K); modern spectroscopy puts it near 16,500 K.
